patch_description: Replace fully-shared input RY with per-qubit RY rotations to allow each qubit to independently process its IsingZZ-encoded features, while keeping shared RZ phase and shared output RY/RX layers for regularization. This balances expressivity (per-qubit input) with generalization (shared output), targeting higher accuracy without overfitting. Goes from 4 to 11 unique params per block (68 total vs 26).
